The '''Imperial crown jewels''' were a vast holding of [[The Jewelry Collection|jewelry]] and gemstones that was acquired by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], analogous to the jewels of [[King/Legends|royalty]].<ref name="">{{CSWECite|II|88|Imperial crown jewels}}</ref>
